meta.purpose: Rule set for the scam/spam/fake-posting filter. Each match adds risk weight. Thresholds map total weight to a Scam Risk Rating.

hard_reject_rules.description: Asks candidate to pay money, buy equipment, pay for training/onboarding, or send a deposit.
Crypto, gift cards, package forwarding, or reshipping language.
Requests SSN, bank details, ID, or sensitive documents before a legitimate offer.

high_risk_rules.description: Recruiting conducted only via Telegram / WhatsApp / Signal chat.
Recruiter uses a personal Gmail/Yahoo/Outlook/Hotmail/AOL/iCloud address instead of a company domain.
Urgent pressure tactics to accept or respond immediately.
Unrealistic pay for minimal/no-experience remote work.
No verifiable company website / no real business presence / vague company name.
patterns: company name will be shared later

medium_risk_rules.description: No clear job duties or responsibilities listed.
Commission-only role marketed as salaried, or clinical title that is really sales/MLM.
Fake clinical/research title that is really a sales, recruiting, or MLM funnel.
Poor grammar, inconsistent company info, or mismatched domains (manual reviewer flag).
Offers a job with no interview or screening.

reviewer_checklist: Does the company have a real website with a careers page listing this role?
Does the recruiter email match the company's actual domain?
Is the salary realistic for the role, market, and Tampa Bay area?
Are duties, location, and requirements clearly and consistently stated?
Is the same posting appearing under multiple different company names?
Is any money, gift card, crypto, or personal financial info requested before an official offer?
Is all recruiting happening off-platform in Telegram/WhatsApp only?
Was contact unsolicited with immediate pressure to accept?

legit_signal_boosts.description: Signals that REDUCE scam risk (negative weight) when present.

rules.description: Application URL is on a known employer or ATS domain.
Posting lists a concrete, market-plausible salary band.
